Initial capacity set at 5000 vehicles/shift/year under first phase of ₹1000 crore investment. Partnerships include CATL (39% global battery share) and BAIC Foton Motor. IIFL Finance Q2FY27 Results: Net profit up 93% YoY to ₹766 crore Consolidated net profit rose 93% YoY to ₹766 crore, beating analyst estimates of ₹735 crore. Assets Under Management expanded 38% YoY to ₹1,24,268 crore, driven by gold loans. Gross NPA improved to 1.48%, down 7 bps QoQ, while Net NPA edged up to 0.87%. Pre-provision operating profit increased 31% YoY to ₹1,355.1 crore
